category: Provide a Mechanism for Verifying Software Release Integrity (PS)
subcategory_text: Make a mechanism available for users and operators to verify the integrity of the released software (e.g., published hashes, signed manifests, attestation).
implementation_examples: Publish signed checksums and SLSA-style provenance for every release
Provide a verification command in the install instructions
Host the verification artefacts on a separate channel from the release artefacts
assessment_objectives: Determine whether a release-integrity verification mechanism is made available to consumers.
Determine whether consumers can validate the integrity before installation.
